job.fullDescription:
About the job
This is a demo job description written for JobsMatchNow. Our cloud team helps enterprise customers move critical systems to the cloud safely, and we are looking for a senior Cloud Architect to lead those designs from first workshop to production.

The role
You will work directly with customer engineering teams and our solutions group. The role includes:
Designing secure, well-architected cloud platforms for regulated customers.
Writing infrastructure as code with Terraform and reviewing it with the customer team.
Running Kubernetes platforms and setting up monitoring, alerting and cost controls.
Leading architecture reviews and explaining trade-offs to technical and business people.
Turning lessons from each project into reusable patterns and short guides.

Who this role is for
It suits someone who:
Takes ownership and follows through without being chased.
Writes things down clearly for a team spread across time zones.
Questions a design that does not look right, and proposes a better one.

What we are looking for
- 6+ years building and running production systems on a major cloud
- Strong Terraform and Kubernetes experience
- Clear written and spoken English
- Python scripting and a security certification are a plus

How we work
Hybrid, two days a week in the Singapore office, with flexible hours. The process is a recruiter screen, a technical deep dive, and a final architecture conversation.

How to apply
Like this role on JobsMatchNow. If we like your profile too, the conversation opens and we will share the next steps.
